learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the smart way to handle money! Discover how to create a family budget, the importance of saving for the future, and how to invest wisely.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Income is the money a family earns. It comes in three forms: Money Income (salary, rent), Real Income (facilities available, like a free company car or homegrown vegetables), and Psychic Income (the satisfaction derived from spending).
A budget is a written plan of how you will spend your expected income. It tracks your income and expenditures, ensuring you don't spend more than you earn and helping you find areas to save.
Saving is keeping a part of your income for future needs. Hoarding is hiding cash under a mattress where it earns no interest. Savings must be put to work.

Investment means putting your saved money into tools (like banks, post offices, mutual funds) so it grows. The main principles are: Safety of the principal amount, Liquidity (easy to withdraw), and a good Rate of Return (interest).
Banks and Post Offices are the most common, safe, and regulated places to save and invest money, offering various schemes like Fixed Deposits (FD) or Recurring Deposits (RD).

fun_activity.title: 📊 The Pocket Money Budget
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you get Rs. 1000 as pocket money for the month. Create a quick budget dividing it into: Needs (transport, stationery), Wants (snacks, movies), and Savings. Try to save at least 20%!

exam_tips: 📌 Clearly define the 3 types of income: Money Income, Real Income, and Psychic Income.
📌 Remember the golden rule of budgeting: Income must always be greater than or equal to Expenditure.
📌 Explain 'Liquidity' in investments: It is how quickly and easily you can turn your investment back into cash in an emergency.
quick_recap: ⭐ A budget brings financial discipline and prevents debt.
⭐ Saving protects you against unforeseen emergencies.
⭐ Smart investments beat inflation by growing your wealth over time.
